facts.text: Two men, one ice rink, and one very big cheese platter. I'm wearing sequins to dinner and nobody can stop me.
facts.why: Invented line signed Chazz Michael Michaels. A real Chazz line: 'Get used to it, Jimmy; you're in Chazz's world now.'
